values.meaning: bonus physical damage on empowered basic attack
values.binNote: Sheet expresses this as an unresolved ByCharLevelFormulaCalculationPart; values here are computed from the wiki's stated level formula 14 + (116-14)/17*(level-1), which the sheet does not spell out numerically.

values.meaning: root duration on empowered basic attack
values.binNote: Sheet lists this as NautilusPassive#RootDuration (a calculation, not a data value as the skeleton's stub labeled it), given directly as byLevelL[0.75/.../1.5] matching the wiki's stated values exactly.

values.meaning: cooldown before the passive can trigger again on the same target

mechanics.claim: The passive triggers off basic attacks, adding bonus physical damage and a brief root; it cannot re-trigger on the same target for several seconds.
mechanics.quote: Nautilus' basic attacks are empowered to deal {{as|{{pp|14 + (116-14)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|physical damage}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and root the target

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks the root but not the bonus damage, so the damage still applies even if the effect is spell-shielded.
mechanics.quote: Spell shield will block the root but not the bonus damage.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack can still be blocked or dodged, and in that case the on-target cooldown is still applied (but presumably no bonus damage lands).
mechanics.quote: Staggering Blow's enhanced attack can be blocked and dodged (the on-target cooldown will still be applied).

mechanics.claim: The passive fails to trigger entirely while Nautilus is blinded.
mechanics.quote: It will fail to trigger while he is blinded.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack (and thus its bonus damage) will not trigger against structures.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack will not trigger against structures.
